basic_info.description: Classic Craftsmanship meets modern elegance!  This beautifully maintained 1920s traditional home in West Portal is flooded with natural light and full of timeless character. A fantastic floor plan is framed by elegant French windows, warm oak floors, and a gracious living room with a fireplace and charming bay window. The front garden, bordered by a white picket fence, adds to the home's inviting curb appeal. The classic eat-in kitchen offers abundant cabinet and counter space, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Spread across three levels, this 5BD/4BA  home provides wonderful separation of space, with thoughtful modern updates and beautifully preserved finishes throughout. The primary suite features a spa-like, light-filled bathroom that feels like a private retreat. Downstairs, a fully equipped guest suite with a separate entrance offers flexibility for visitors, extended family. A private, sheltered brick patio creates the perfect outdoor escape. Just blocks from the vibrant West Portal shopping district, local parks, and Muni Metro lines, this home is ideally located on one of the neighborhood's most desirable blocks.
